title: Pricing and What Is Included | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Request wedding pricing for R&SVP – Hio Ridge in Bridgton, Maine. Tables and chairs are included. Explore the spaces and ask Susan about rental details.
heading: Wedding pricing and rental details
lede: From the ceremony field to dinner beneath the beams, you can celebrate here on the same farm. Tables and chairs are included with rental. Request our pricing brochure for the rental cost. Susan can confirm which spaces and services your rental covers. [CONFIRM: which spaces and services are included in the wedding rental]
price_note: We host weddings on Sundays and weekdays, May through October. When comparing prices, check the rental hours and full list of inclusions. [CONFIRM: weekday and event rates]
included_heading: Spaces and facilities at the farm
included: Dining spaces on the barn's main floor and in the loft. Confirm the seated layout for your guest count
A bridal room and a separate groom's room in the ell
A ceremony field facing Pleasant Mountain, with benches made from old floorboards
A patio with string lights and a stone seating circle
Tables and chairs included with rental, with long tables and 5 foot rounds
A prep kitchen for your outside caterer
Parking for 66 cars, plus three accessible spaces
An ADA bathroom and a ramp to the barn's main floor
Susan and Richard on site at events
[CONFIRM: setup and breakdown, hours of access, rehearsal time]
compare: We host weddings without alcohol. Guests of all ages are welcome, and you won't need to budget for alcohol. [CONFIRM: Susan is comfortable with this comparison]
events_heading: A shower or reunion *around the barn tables.*
events: We also host family gatherings and other events for up to 135 guests. Share the type of event and your approximate guest count with Susan for pricing. [CONFIRM: event rates]

closing.heading: See the barn *with your plans in mind.*
closing.body: You can request the pricing brochure before booking a tour. A season and an approximate guest count give Susan a starting point.
